# TPC-Havoc Q3_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    l_orderkey,
    (select sum(l2.l_extendedprice * (1 - l2.l_discount))
     from lineitem l2
     where l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
       and l2.l_shipdate > date '1995-03-15') as revenue,
    o_orderdate,
    o_shippriority
from
    customer,
    orders,
    lineitem l1
where
    c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
    and c_custkey = o_custkey
    and l1.l_orderkey = o_orderkey
    and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-15'
    and l1.l_shipdate > date '1995-03-15'
group by
    l_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_shippriority
order by
    revenue desc,
    o_orderdate
```
